BebboSSH 1.46.1: SSH2 client, server, scp and key generator for the Amiga
(68020 and up), as published on Aminet:

  https://aminet.net/comm/net/bebbossh_1.46.1.lha   ($VER: 1.46.1)
    sha256 a2c588a59a44f81fed3e2890b43cf5ff437e116cdcbfa26b0441382f95bc0bb1
    (393853 bytes, fetched 2026-10-14; SHA256SUMS here lists the files taken
    from it and the 1.45 source tarball)
    An UNOFFICIAL modified build by Matthias Muench of Stefan "Bebbo"
    Franke's BebboSSH 1.45, with the upstream 1.46 key-exchange fix merged
    and security fixes (see bebbossh.readme, CHANGES 0001-0019).
    The Aminet archive's binaries are NOT shipped. UP-Term builds its own
    from the source and patches below (make bebbossh, tools/build_bebbossh.sh;
    the build's SHA256SUMS and TOOLCHAIN.txt are in the kit's drawer):
    bebbossh, bebboscp, bebbosshkeygen, bebbosshd (68020 builds),
    libcryptossh.library020 (68020-68040,
    68080), libcryptossh.library060 (68060). The plain 68000 library of the
    readme is not built: the kit needs a 68020.
    bebbossh.readme, bebbossh.readme.orig (Bebbo's original 1.46 readme),
    COPYING, template/sshd_config, patches/: from the archive
    (template/passwd, the author's sample login, is left out; so are the
    Linux builds, the icon and the xterm-amiga terminfo)

  The complete corresponding source is in this drawer:
    bebbossh-1.45-src.tar.bz2: the author's repository
    https://franke.ms/git/bebbo/bebbossh at commit 057c7f3 ("cleanup and
    release 1.45"), the base of this build.
    patches/0001..0019: the changes, applied in order on top of it
    (patch -p1 in the unpacked bebbossh-1.45 directory; tested: all 19
    apply). Build steps are in bebbossh.readme (BUILD).

Build: Bebbo's m68k-amigaos-gcc, "m68k-amigaos-gcc (GCC) 6.5.0b 20260819091705"
(the fork's author used the 2026-03-03 snapshot; the code differs in size
only, the strings are the same). The source's own Makefile and flags, as in
its mkrelease and the BUILD section of bebbossh.readme:
  make CPU=-m68020 STRIP="-s -Wl,--gc-sections" Release=1 <programs> libcryptossh.library
  (CPU=-m68060 and no CPU for the other two library variants, make clean
  between the builds)
Two additions to those flags, build time only: CC gets "-include
hardware/custom.h" (src/log.c uses struct Custom and relied on a newer
NDK's transitive include), and C++FLAGS gets -I to the libcodesets 6.22
headers (github.com/jens-maus/libcodesets, 34442b7), which bebbossh.cpp
includes and the installed NDK lacks; no libcodesets code is linked.
The binaries carry the build date in their $VER.

Licence: GNU General Public License version 3 or later (COPYING, beside
this file); some files are public domain, as their headers say.
UP-Term installs the client tools in UP-Term:bin and the library in
LIBS: (README, NETWORK); thoughts/shared/research/2026-10-03_ssh-for-up-term.md
in UP-Term's source has what was measured on 1.45.
